reviews.t: Worth the time spent and the money saved!
reviews.x: This was a Christmas gift I had been asking for - I’ve had professional lash lifts in the past but having to get them every 4-6 weeks at $55-$60 a pop can get expensive quick. I’ve only done one eye so far but very happy w/ the results - sometimes I didn’t see this type of curl when walking out of the salon!  The adhesion part is to me the trickiest and the most frustrating.  But just be patient.  I did have to keep an eye (hahaha) on it b/c the lashes didn’t always want to stay stuck to the pad

reviews.t: Beautiful Lashes for a Great Price!
reviews.x: This product is so easy to use! It works SO WELL! Better than other brands I have tried. The perming solution is great! Definitely have to leave it on for the full recommended time, but it really works wonders. I have naturally very straight eyelashes and this makes them curl beautifully. And it lasts for 1-2 months depending on how well I take care of my lashes! Overall I absolutely recommend this product. You won’t be sorry!

Your probably purchasing this because you YouTubed a DIY for brow lamination. This is the product for that! My brows came out bomb, so worth it ! I would say be very particular and patient when combing the hairs up because if the glue dries you’ll end up ripping some brow hairs.

reviews.t: Great product. Should use a different glue. If you have sensitive skin don’t use it
reviews.x: My lashes look very good! I would recommend getting a different glue. And if you have sensitive skin or are allergic to a lot of makeup/ skincare items DO NOT USE THIS PRODUCT!! While my lashes look great, I broke out all over my eyelids with welps and blisters!
Loved it. A bit finicky to use, but worth the time and effort

reviews.t: Glue doesn't stick, perm didn't work whatsoever
reviews.x: Received this as a gift from my mom and decided to try it this weekend. Not sure if it's just my lashes & very round eye shape or what, but I couldn't get any of the pads to sit right on my eyes. The glue doesn't hold my lashes at all and I was left having to hold them down during the perm and fixation processes the entire 12 mins each. Afterwards, my lashes weren't lifted at all and I was left with irritated eyes from the plastic getting some of the perm into my eyes. Had my husband attempt the

reviews.t: Does a great job at curling lashes
reviews.x: I love my lashes now! I’ve been wanting to get lash extensions for a while now but feared losing my natural lashes. When I found out about lash lifting kits I looked into it right away and read every review I could. Ended up purchasing this one due to the cost and overall rating. Glad I did! My lashes look soo much better now and it’s changed my confidence, I don’t do my makeup nearly as much as I use to because I don’t feel like I need to anymore! My only complaint is the glue. It’s was really

This kit was the first I’ve used of its kind. As I was using the kit I wasn’t sure if I was going to like the results or if the work it took would be worth it. But when I saw the results I definitely thought it was worth it and loved the results. I have hooded eyelids that can make my eyes seem small and sleepy almost, and it was amazing how much this product opened up my eyes and made them look bigger and brighter both with and without make up. It’s been a couple weeks now and my eyelashes stil

I’ve used a different brand on Amazon before and when I saw this on the lightning deal, it was too good to pass up.  I’ve used this twice. Good news, the product works. Almost too well. I used a medium and it curled my lashes too much. I might have left it on too long. Bad news, it might be too strong...for me.  Both times that I used it, I woke up the next morning with eye irritation.  Yes, this does work. It takes time and patience. Definitely follow the directions and use a timer!

It worked fine the first time I used it.  The lash glue is terrible, so use your own.  You need to sit with it and keep brushing your lashes up.  I just tried to use it for the second time a couple months later and it didn't work at all.  There was zero change.  I don't think it's worth the price given that you only get one use out of it, and now I'll have to wait another couple weeks before I try again because I don't know if this last attempt damaged my lashes.

reviews.t: Easy to use and lasts forever!
reviews.x: It only took about 30 minutes to do and it was super easy! So far I have done it on myself, friend, and sister, and I barely have anything missing. My lashes after 3 weeks still look like I just did the lash lift. I also colored my lashes with beard dye, so I don't even wear mascara anymore. I have put on makeup and worn fake lashes/mascara with more dramatic looks, and it doesn't affect the perm at all! Great product and highly recommend.

It’s quite easy to do yourself, but the glue is kind of weak so it takes a lot of patience and arm strength to keep it in place. Some of my eyelashes refuse to stick onto the rod and you can’t add more glue on top of the already stuck eyelashes because then the perm solution doesn’t work so you kind of end up with some curls and a few random straight ones. It works perfectly fine but you would definitely might need a friend to help you.

Great Product! It took me a bit of time to understand the instructions but once I did the process was so easy! It took me about 45 minutes for the whole process but it was so worth it. It has been around one month already but my lashes are still staying up. My lashes are perfectly healthy and there has been no rashes. Overall, I had a really good experience with this product and will be buying from them again!

I was really scared to use this product at first but decided to give it a go anyways. I didn’t leave the solutions on long enough so I didn’t really get to full effect, but regardless my lashes still looked lifted and they stayed like that for about one and a half months. I’m gonna be giving this another go. You can use this multiple times. So much better than paying $80 upward to get it done at a salon!

has pros and cons. pro is that it does perm your lashes really nice on the first go and that it lasts for a few weeks. cons are that the glue provided isn’t sticky enough and you can really only use it for a one-time use. I’ve purchased this product many times and whenever I would go back for a second use a few weeks later, the products wouldn’t work and I’d be left with flat lashes

The glue that was with this product did not work at all it was not sticky and it never dried up. and when i used another glue the perming lotion just made my eyes burn when it was not even touching my eyes i sent the product back because it was doing too much damage to my eyes that it was not worth it at all. dont try this product please. save yourself

My first time reviewing. But this kit really does work. I had a little difficulty with the pads because it was too long. So I cut the sides. The adhesive wasn’t strong enough. But other than that. It’s been about 3 weeks or so and my lashes are still curled. I feel more confident going out knowing I can rub my eyes and not worry about flat lashes.

As a licensed professional I do not recommend this product. My spa owner purchased this from Amazon, when I went to try it on a PAYING CLIENT,  the glue did absolutely nothing. If the glue doesn't work then the service cannot proceed. I have done this service on many clients with a different brand and had success. This product not at all.

This product didn't work well for my eyelashes: the glue is not strong enough to fully stick your lashes for the duration of the process and the curl at the end was weak because I had to continually re-adhere my lashes. However, this kit worked very well for an at home brow lamination. I would recommend you use a different stronger glue.

claims.text: Most reviewers find the kit easy to use and effective, with clear instructions and good results.
Many say it is worth the money, especially compared to expensive professional lash lifts.
Some reviewers find it finicky or tricky to apply, especially getting the pads and glue to sit right.
A few reviewers report problems with the glue not holding lashes or the perm not working.
Some warn that the product may irritate sensitive skin, causing breakouts or blisters.
